configuration.auditEvents: Only the untimed audit reports one incident after60 steps and one one-second penalty after120 steps through actual public APIs, then continues real stepping. Normal timed cases do not inject these reports.

stateOracle.method: Actual own-object graph: Object.is numeric leaves, exact typed-array bytes, class names, object/array keys, references, Map/Set insertion order, function-source identities, race/terrain events and packed frames.
stateOracle.inaccessible: ECMAScript #fields and closure-captured storage are not reflected. The Track heat accumulator and thermal cache are not directly inspected. Actual continuation and surface arrays are compared; W07B separately observes raw thermal call inputs/outputs.
stateOracle.metricPolicy: No frame masking: both actual writeFrame calls receive stepMs=0 and dropped=0.
stateOracle.nonfinitePolicy: Packed frames, physical body state and public surface grids must be finite. Identical internal sentinels such as uninitialised aero NaN and AI time -Infinity are retained and counted, not removed.
stateOracle.immutableGeometry: Track geometry/index acceleration data are omitted explicitly; source identities and prior actual Track equivalence probes cover their inputs. Other own graph state remains present.

concurrency.limitation: A cooperative lock cannot detect unrelated CPU/GPU work; the timing coordinator must arrange exclusivity.

scope.timedWork: For each step: apply the precomputed control, execute declared owner/pit edges, call actual Simulation.step(1/120), and write the actual complete Float32 frame every second step with metric arguments (0,0).
scope.setupWork: Construct the actual 4-vehicle practice Simulation, prime 240 actual physics steps, allocate input objects and every frame view, then retain exact output observations after execution.
scope.allocationScope: Fixture construction, input/frame allocation, reflection, copies, hashing and comparison are outside run. All allocations from actual step/writeFrame and the small identical declared event log remain inside. No forced GC or heap saving claim.
scope.limitations: Local combined Simulation CPU; 1 measured simulated seconds. Priming advances the actual world; moving vehicles still enter new cells. This is not game FPS, a browser/worker/GPU result, a whole lap or a long-session proof.
